info.title: bConnect Defense Control API
info.description:
With DefenseControl, relevant security configurations as well as endpoint threats detected by MicrosoftDefender can be viewed. In addition, orchestration of the Microsoft BitLocker tool enables reliable protection of endpoint hard disks (see documentation).

The APIs provided here allow reading BitLocker related information, MicrosoftDefender status and detected threats on Windows endpoints.

get.summary: Get information concerning BitLocker for all windows endpoints

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
Sorts results by property name and with sort direction. Multiple properties are separated by comma.
Possible values are EndpointId or EndpointName (e.g. EndpointName asc).

parameters.name: SearchQuery
parameters.description:
Filters results by matching the given value against searchable properties.
Searchable values are EndpointName.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The zero-indexed number of the first page that begins the set of pages that are returned in the response.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of items to list on a single page. For example, if page_size is 10, each page shows ten items.
A valid value is a non-negative, non-zero integer. The default value is 20. Maximum value is 1000.

get.summary: Get information concerning BitLocker for a specific windows endpoint

404.description: A windows endpoint with the specified id does not exist

get.summary: Get local admin account information for a specific windows endpoint

404.description: A windows endpoint with the specified id does not exist or the user doesn't have the required rights to access the object.

409.description: This action can not be executed on a disabled device.

patch.summary: Change the expiration date of local admin account for a specific windows endpoint. You can only patch the 'requested expiration date'. Setting the property to a date in the past will trigger the generation of new credentials on the endpoint. The requested expiration date is set until the client acknowledges the request. After acknowledging the request, the 'requested expiration date' will be set to 'null' and the 'expiration date' will contain the new expiration date. You can trigger an immediate update of the expiration date on an endpoint by using the 'TriggerUpdateOnClient' [POST] action.

requestBody.description: A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object. The example document contains all modifiable properties.

404.description: A windows endpoint with the specified id does not exist or isn't visible.

403.description: The bConnect user does not have the required local admin user privileges for the client.

409.description: This action can not be executed on a disabled device.

post.summary: Request a client to immediately update the expiration date of its' local administrative account. This only works if the client is online. You can specify a timeout with the 'timeout' query parameter. The default timeout is 30 seconds

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The timeout to use for the request. Must be between 0 and 60 seconds.

200.description: Returns 'true' if the client changed its' expiration date. 'false' if the client could not be reached at this time.

404.description: A windows endpoint with the specified id does not exist or isn't visible.

403.description: The bConnect user does not have the required local admin user privileges for the client.

409.description: This action can not be executed on a disabled device.

get.summary: Retrieves information concerning Microsoft Defender state for a single windows endpoint

200.description: Returns the current Microsoft Defender state

404.description: A windows endpoint with the specified id does not exist

isSecureBootEnabled.description: If set secure boot is enabled on this client

isStartupPinEnabled.description: If set BitLocker Startup PIN is enabled on this client

isStartupUsbKeyEnabled.description: If set BitLocker Startup USB Key is enabled on this client

networkUnlockStatus.description: The status of Network Unlock Feature on Client

username.description: The username of the local administrative user

password.description: The password of the local administrative user

expirationDate.description: The current expiration date of the credentials, which is known by the client

requestedExpirationDate.description: The requested expiration date of the credentials, which is not yet known by the client. If this is null no new expiration date is requested.

localAdminAccount.description: The local admin account data of the endpoint

highestSeverity.description: The severity of the highest active threat

isMicrosoftDefenderActive.description: Indicates, if Microsoft Defender is activated on the device

microsoftDefenderState.description: Information about Microsoft Defender actuality and findings

engineVersion.description: The network inspection system engine version

definitionCreation.description: The network inspection system definition creation

definitionVersion.description: The network inspection system definition version

NetworkUnlockStatus.description:
Deactivated: BitLocker Network Unlock is not active, User needs to enter BitLocker PIN at startup.
OtherCertificate: BitLocker Network Unlock is active, but not configured for using with bMS.Installed BitLocker Network Unlock Certificate is unknown.
Activated: BitLocker Network Unlock is active, System boots without requesting PIN, if connected per LAN
NotSupported: BitLocker Network Unlock is not supported on device
Unknown: BitLockerNetworkUnlock status was not inventorised yet.

index.description: Disk index of the storage medium

busType.description: Bus type used by the storage medium

partitionStyle.description: Partition style of the storage medium

isSystemVolume.description: Indicates whether the volume contains the operating system

isOwned.description: Indicates whether the TPM has an owner

isActive.description: Indicates whether the threat is active or not

domainUser.description: The domain user at threat detection time

fileNames.description: File names detected by Microsoft Defender Antivirus, separated by newline

actionSuccess.description: Indicates whether threat could be resolved or not

detectionTime.description: The detection time of the threat

lastStatusChangedTime.description: The last time the status of threat changed

endpointId.description: The id of endpoint where threat was detected

endpointName.description: The name of endpoint where threat was detected

basicAuth.description: Input your username and password to access this API
